authorship: Codex experiment protocol, frozen before any held-out reads are processed.

primary_screen_comparison.downstream: Existing FASTP, viral Bowtie2, human and other-contaminant Bowtie2, score threshold20, original taxonomy and duplicate marking; no downstream threshold tuning on held-out data.

protein_path.control: NT24 original nucleotide path on exactly the same sampled raw pairs
steps: Original human and other-contaminant nucleotide filters
Exact trimmed nucleotide-pair deduplication with multiplicity retained
DIAMOND blastx against six-frame viral genomic translations
NCBI LCA of near-best viral assignments
Independent search against current nr snapshot, including nonviral competitors

NR_validation.policy: Report viral-only, mixed/competing nonviral, no alignment, and unknown-taxonomy evidence separately. No alignment is unvalidated, not a proven false hit.

protein_path.evaluation_order: Begin with the first200 samples in the predetermined random manifest order; expand up to1000 based only on measured throughput, available time and cost, without changing parameters. Report the actual completed scope.

development_only: AA8 andAA10 threshold exploration, including protein10 engineering prototype
primary_metrics: Final per-sample assignments: gains, losses and taxonomic changes
Original coordinate/similarity exemplars for nucleotide arms
Common exact-sequence pair counts when comparing protein and nucleotide arms
Candidate burden, CPU time, memory, runtime and cost
limits: Environmental samples do not supply known-truth sensitivity or specificity.
Extra reads do not establish a new virus or a new infected person.
Five million pairs per sample is reduced-depth block sampling, separate from the247633776-pair full-depth anchor.
Samples from related sites and dates are correlated.
Protein evidence has its own schema and scoring; it is not represented as nucleotide SAM scores.

resource_limits.privacy: All results private; no external publishing.
